notes: Camif (camif.fr, France) - direct HTTP fetch, no WAF/block. Qty verified via the site's rendered French 'N articles' header: 117 articles, page 1 shows 46 tiles with rel=next href=/c/nouveautes?page=2 present, consistent with a genuine multi-page listing (header trusted per this site's proven-reliable count-header pattern from the prior Home-Decor pass verification). Also checked and excluded: 'ventes-privees.html' (private-sales CMS landing page - members-only event page, not a new-arrivals product listing). Checked main nav, footer, and sitemap.categories.xml/sitemap.cms.xml for other New Arrivals terms (nouveaute, nouveau, just-in, dernieres-arrivees, nouvelle-collection) - Nouveautes is the only genuine match.
